# Start LaunchAgent
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.start.task` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/launchd.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, lifecycle |
Kickstarts the job immediately. With `-k`, an already-running job is
restarted (functions as a "reload"). The job must already be loaded
(`launchd.install.task`) for this to succeed.
